_doc: THE DASHBOARDS of Capital-Stack-FinTerminal (#1335): one per FinTerm entry (build.json::ui.stacks, kind dashboard, `dashboard` = the id here). A panel names its `source` (an id of data/sources.json whose `feeds` lists this entry) and EITHER a `fetch` (a live connector: the key-free sources) OR a `placeholder` ({reason, note}: drawn as one 48dp key row while the source needs a key / has no connector yet, 'Add your key in Config > Sources'; UI spec 2). UI declarations (UI spec 6.3): dashboard `default` (the tab opens on it) and `search` (a search field on top); panel `display` (kpi | rows | heat | watch), `tape` (its quotes feed the ticker tape), `spread` ({label, of: [a, b]}: a derived KPI tile in bp), `heat_scale`, `segment_of` / `segment_label` (drawn as a source chip of another panel's card), `refresh_s`, `col_types`, `limit`. Providers and derivations are named here and implemented in Kotlin (Providers.kt, Derive.kt); no address is typed anywhere but data/sources.json (endpoint) because a request is endpoint + path + params. Read by Dashboards.kt and by test/test-finterm-sources.sh.
_doc_fetch: provider: fred_series (one request per series: id + cosd = today - lookback_days), dbnomics_series (path + params; params.dimensions is JSON-encoded), imf_datamapper (path, params; countries filters the answer), worldbank_indicator (path with {countries} joined by ';'), gdelt_artlist (path + params). derive: how the parsed data becomes rows/chart: latest_curve, forward_grid, latest_per_series, imf_latest, worldbank_latest, level_change, fx_spot, fx_cross, articles. view: curve (line chart), bars (bar chart + table), table, news, alloc (model portfolio legs). fallback (fred_series): {source} names the second-priority public source, tried series by series after the primary and the panel's own source returned nothing; a series carries its code there as `dbnomics` ("<provider>/<dataset>/<series>", read at endpoint + /series/<code>); a series with no code has no second source.

_doc_primary: fetch.primary: the panel's preferred route. source = a source of data/sources.json (priority 0, feeding this entry) reached on the private mesh; topic = the DataHub topic read per series (GET <paths.peek>), with {id} the series id. Its answer {series_id, observations:[{date, value}]} feeds the same derivation as the public source; a topic the container has not published, or a mesh that does not answer, falls back to the panel's own source. Only the fred_series panels declare one today (the connector's topic pattern is econ:fred:*); the other providers' topic shapes are not declared yet.
_doc_model: Model panels (design 1/3.4): derive points | events | candles | kv | filings, view quotes | calendar | candles | kv (+ curve, bars, table, news). fetch: provider = the panel source's connector; path + params with slots {each} {each_csv} {yyyymm} {prev_yyyymm} {from} {today} {cik}; each = one request per item (each_days N = the next N dates; each_user = a user list, e.g. the watchlist, replaces it when set); labels = key -> label (and the keys kept, in order); years = key -> x of a curve; key_dim = the SDMX / JSON-stat dimension that names a series; lookback_days, last, scale, forms, cik. primary = {source: cloud_fincept, api: a /v1 path, params, parse: finterm_v1}: tried first when the mesh answers; then the panel's own source; then fallbacks[] in order ({source, provider, path, params, each}); merge true = every route that answers is combined (calendars), else the first that answers wins. filter (events): days_back, days_ahead, importance_min. alerts: price | event = the panel evaluates the user's alert rules.
